task.name: cut_sausage
task.description: Use the right arm to pick up the knife from the knife holder, cut a small piece of sausage and put it back on the knife holder.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the knife holder.
2. Grasp the knife from the knife holder.
3. Move the right arm to align with the sausage.
4. Cut a small piece of sausage.
5. Move the right arm to align with the knife holder.
6. Release the gripper to put the knife back on the knife holder.
